column1: #  - module is a class (the unit that is instantiated, with parameters and members); interface is an interface; package is a package; class is a class;
#  - function and task are functions, and methods when declared inside a class; `function new()` has no name of its own and is not a definition;
#  - parameter and localparam are constants wherever declared (module parameter port list, module body, package, interface), one per name; type parameters are not definitions;
#  - typedef is a type_alias (enumeration members are not definitions); class properties are fields;
#  - ports, nets, registers, module variables, instances (alu a0 (..)) and calls are not definitions.
